The structure of Ca12Cr2Rh4 (reduced formula Ca6CrRh2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1md (No. 143), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ca atoms show 12 geometric neighbors (Ca, Cr, Rh), while Cr and Rh each show 12 neighbors with mixed Ca/Cr and Ca/Rh compositions, respectively. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ca-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner/edge sharing between Cr- and Rh-centered polyhedra.
